subtopics.title: Determine the union
subtopics.exposition: The union of two sets is a new set that contains all of the elements that are in at least one of the two sets. The union of sets A and B is written as A∪B, or as "A or B". The union of two events in a sample space can be shown using a Venn diagram, for different configurations of the two events.

subtopics.title: Determine the intersection
subtopics.exposition: The intersection of two sets is a new set that contains all of the elements that are in both sets. The intersection of sets A and B is written as A∩B, or as "A and B". The intersection of two events in a sample space can be shown using a Venn diagram, for different configurations of the two events.
